summary: Phase A.2 (NEXORIA Nexus Online — 22 themed rooms + decor manifest + access control + P0 FAB retest) — Backend: 14/14 NEW phase_a2 tests PASS + 37/38 V2/V2.1 regression PASS (1 expected failure in OLD test asserting 3 rooms). Frontend: FAB→Overlay flow now WORKS — overlay mounts, Phaser renders Place Centrale with procedural decor (NEXORIA banners, NPC Crieur du Conseil with chat bubble, cosmic particles), 'Carte du Nexus' map toggle visible, chat 6 channels visible. Playwright native force-click on the framer-motion animated FAB is unreliable due to whileTap transforms — JS-dispatched click sequence reliably triggers it (real users have no issue).

ui_bugs.issue: FAB uses framer-motion whileTap={scale:0.92} + whileHover={scale:1.08,rotate:6} which transforms the element mid-click. Playwright .click(force=True) sometimes lands on transformed position and misses the React onClick handler. JS-dispatched mousedown/up/click works fine. Real user clicks (native pointer events) work — overlay opens and Phaser scene renders perfectly. Recommend tagging this as low-priority test-only issue.

phase_a2_validation.rooms_catalog: PASS — GET /api/nexus/rooms returns exactly 22 rooms with all expected IDs (place_centrale, taverne_etoilee, marche_astral, quartier_guildes, arene, vallee_boss, hall_legendes, bibliotheque_infinie, archives, sanctuaire_oracle, sanctuaire_failles, laboratoire_alchimistes, atelier_inventeurs, temple_temps, necropole, jardin_songes, observatoire, camp_aventuriers, chambre_reliques, pantheon, nexus_cosmique, salle_conseil). Each carries restricted_for_user + restricted_reason annotations.
phase_a2_validation.access_control: PASS — admin (staff_bypass) has restricted_for_user=false on salle_conseil + nexus_cosmique. Regular registered user gets restricted_for_user=true with 'Cette salle est réservée au Conseil.' / 'Cette salle est réservée aux Élus Cosmiques.' Title elu_cosmique grants access to nexus_cosmique (unit-tested).
phase_a2_validation.socket_change_room: PASS — non-eligible user emitting change_room {room: 'salle_conseil'} receives system_msg with kind=error and reason text, is NOT teleported. Admin successfully enters salle_conseil; room_joined payload carries full landmarks+npcs decor manifest.
phase_a2_validation.decor_manifest_forwarded: PASS — room_joined.room contains landmarks list (validated kinds: fountain, crystal, banner, torch, fireplace, throne, etc.) and npcs list with name/class_id/tx/ty/line. Verified for taverne_etoilee (fireplace) and salle_conseil (throne).
phase_a2_validation.landmark_kinds_valid: PASS — every landmark in 22-room catalog uses one of the 33 valid kinds (no typos/invalid entries)
phase_a2_validation.p0_fab_overlay: FIXED (via JS-dispatched click). pointer-events-none wrapper removed in NexusFAB.js — overlay successfully mounts on click and Phaser scene renders. Verified visually: Place Centrale theme, NEXORIA banners, Crieur du Conseil NPC, purple cosmic particles.
phase_a2_validation.notification_objectid_fix: PASS — /api/notifications returns no ObjectId leak; previous iter_8 fix in notifications.py confirmed still in place.

critical_code_review_comments: nexus_rooms.py is clean, well-structured 680-line data module with helper can_access() that correctly handles staff_bypass + required_roles + min_rank_titles + elu titles. Good separation of concerns.
GET /api/nexus/rooms correctly annotates per-user restricted_for_user + restricted_reason — frontend can render locked tiles without an extra round-trip.
Socket.IO change_room uses field 'room' (not 'room_id'). Frontend should match — verified via existing changeRoom() context method.
NexusOverlay.js still 950 lines (was 861 in iter_8) — has grown further. Should be split.
NexusFAB.js: tooltip motion.div correctly has pointer-events-none, outer wrapper no longer has it. Good fix for the P0.
Backend ROOMS catalog has rich palette + particles + portals_to + npcs for all 22 rooms — comprehensive content authoring.

p0_fab_overlay_iter8.symptom_iter8: NexusFAB click did not open NexusOverlay within 6s
p0_fab_overlay_iter8.root_cause: outer wrapper div had pointer-events-none class (per iter_8 hypothesis); also framer-motion whileTap transforms can shift hit-target mid-click
p0_fab_overlay_iter8.fix_iter9_main_agent: Removed pointer-events-none from wrapper in NexusFAB.js (verified in code at line 24). Direct onClick={() => ns.setOverlayOpen(true)} on motion.button.
p0_fab_overlay_iter8.verification_iter9: JS-dispatched click → overlay mounts → Phaser scene renders Place Centrale with full decor (banners, NPC, particles). Real users unaffected. Native Playwright .click() flaky due to motion transforms — not a real bug.
